```{python}
import re
import yaml
from IPython.display import display, Markdown, HTML

def readable_list(_s):
    if len(_s) < 3:
        return ' and '.join(map(str, _s))
    *a, b = _s
    return f"{', '.join(map(str, a))}, and {b}"

def button(url, str, icon):
    icon_base = icon[:2]
    return f"""<a class="pub-btn" href="{url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><i class="{icon_base} {icon}" role='img' aria-label='{str}'></i>{str}</a>"""

def cite_button(cite_file):
    return f"""<a class="pub-btn" href="research/{cite_file}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><i class="bi bi-journal-text" role='img' aria-label='Cite'></i>Cite</a>"""

def format_inline(text):
    return re.sub(r"__(.+?)__", r"<strong>\1</strong>", text)

def format_abstract(text):
    """Turn a plain-text abstract (blank-line paragraphs, '- ' bullet
    lists, __bold__) into real HTML instead of dumping it as one
    unbroken block of text."""
    paragraphs = [p.strip() for p in text.strip().split("\n\n") if p.strip()]
    html_parts = []
    for para in paragraphs:
        lines = [l.strip() for l in para.split("\n") if l.strip()]
        if lines and all(l.startswith("- ") for l in lines):
            items = "".join(f"<li>{format_inline(l[2:])}</li>" for l in lines)
            html_parts.append(f"<ul>{items}</ul>")
        else:
            html_parts.append(f"<p>{format_inline(' '.join(lines))}</p>")
    return "".join(html_parts)

def details_section(abstract):
    return f"""<details class="pub-abstract">
        <summary>Abstract</summary>
        <div class="abstract">{format_abstract(abstract)}</div>
    </details>"""


yaml_data = yaml.safe_load(open("./research/papers.yaml"))
pub_strs = {"pubs": {}, "wps": {}}
for _, data in yaml_data.items():
    title_str = data["title"]
    authors = data.get("authors", ["me"])
    authors = [aut if aut != "me" else "<strong>Lino Galiana</strong>" for aut in authors]
    author_str = readable_list(authors)
    year_str = data["year"]

    buttons = []
    preprint = data.get("preprint")
    if preprint is not None:
        buttons.append(button(preprint, "Preprint", "bi-file-earmark-pdf"))

    github = data.get("github")
    if github is not None:
        buttons.append(button(github, "Github", "bi-github"))

    pub_url = data.get("published_url")
    venue = data.get("venue")
    working_paper = pub_url is None
    
    pub_str = f'{author_str}. ({year_str}) "{title_str}."'

    if venue is not None:
        pub_str += f" <em>{venue}</em>"

    # Add the details section with the abstract (some older entries use
    # "summary" instead of "abstract")
    abstract = data.get("abstract") or data.get("summary")
    if abstract is not None:
        pub_str += details_section(abstract)

    if working_paper:
        if year_str not in pub_strs["wps"]:
            pub_strs["wps"][year_str] = []
        pub_strs["wps"][year_str].append(
            "<li class='list-group-item'>" + pub_str + "<div class='pub-buttons'>" + "".join(buttons) + "</div></li>"
        )
    else:
        if year_str not in pub_strs["pubs"]:
            pub_strs["pubs"][year_str] = []
        buttons.append(button(pub_url, "Published", "ai-archive"))

        cite_file = data.get("cite")
        if cite_file is not None:
            buttons.append(cite_button(cite_file))
            
        pub_strs["pubs"][year_str].append(
            "<li class='list-group-item'>" + pub_str + "<div class='pub-buttons'>" + "".join(buttons) + "</div></li>"
        )

```
